name: NG exhaustion focused POX lesson proposal

current_findings.lesson: Focused POX case identity and authoritative FLIP/SAME labels come from the fixed 3,429 master ledger. Canonical events and raw tape are enrichment/join sources, not population constructors.
current_findings.do_not_learn: Do not derive or replace the 3,429 population by enumerating consecutive canonical P/O/X seed-state triples or any other alternative population definition.

current_findings.lesson: Preserve losing, zero, short, delayed, choppy, false, low-confidence and temporarily non-executable POX rows. Executability and checkpoint availability are annotations, not membership filters.

Model POX as a two-stage state-transition problem: first monetize/predict the strong initial continuation, then separately predict/manage the later FLIP versus SAME/delayed branch. Do not skip the initial continuation by jumping directly to the later branch.
Use the earliest causal POX checkpoint that independently validates on chronological OOT data. Later confirmation is fallback only when the earlier point is not sufficiently actionable.

The contamination-safe generic D1 +0 early-entry study failed its tune profitability gate and was essentially flat gross in confirmation before costs. Therefore generic D1 immediate-entry economics may not be borrowed as a POX execution rule; POX must validate its own fixed-population economics.
FLIP/SAME is a future label until its own causal knowability point. Predict it from causal prefixes if possible, but never backdate realized branch identity into the initial POX trade.

A later successor exhaustion/branch checkpoint is a new causal state origin. Older POX ancestry is not automatically inherited; continue/reverse/follow-successor/stand-down actions require their own validated economics.

Delayed SAME re-expression remains a watch/re-entry research lane after the original +60 management boundary. A realized later recovery never erases the original loss and never creates automatic re-entry permission.

research_state.target_A_earliest_pox_identity: PENDING_FIXED_LEDGER_JOIN; BINARY MEMBERSHIP MODEL ALSO REQUIRES HONEST CANDIDATE_CONTROL_UNIVERSE

failed_or_rejected_paths: REJECTED: defining the 3,429 focused population as literal consecutive canonical P/O/X triples with a following event.
REJECTED: allowing a generated runner to infer authoritative FLIP/SAME labels from canonical adjacency.
REJECTED: borrowing generic D1 +0 immediate-entry economics into POX without standalone validation.
REJECTED: deleting or sidelining valid rows because they are difficult, delayed, losing, choppy or unavailable at an early checkpoint.
do_not_learn: Do not reopen or re-litigate 3,429 / 1,444 / 1,985 in the next research chat.
Do not treat the older 679-case Phase-2 subset as the focused master population.
Do not use canonical adjacency to reconstruct master POX membership.
Do not use D0-D5 independent result artifacts during standalone POX rule selection.
Do not backdate FLIP/SAME branch knowledge.
Do not automatically inherit old POX state through a newly confirmed successor.
Do not automatically re-enter delayed SAME recovery.
Do not merge this proposal into permanent Frankie or freeze a play without explicit authorization and fresh prospective/OOT promotion.
